advice_bullets: • Prices likely to rise — consider storing produce to sell later for better returns. (Planting season: planting season—supply typically low; planting inputs and labor demand are high.)
• Use proper post-harvest handling to prevent losses during storage.
• Monitor local demand and transport to time sales for peak prices. Risk: input shortages and variable planting -> future supply uncertain.
